search: Search title, author, year, or tag
notebookTip: Paper documents are created under the Zotero root document in this notebook.
rootNameTip: Defaults to Zotero; existing paper notes are moved under the new root automatically.
autoImportTip: Reads the Zotero library index without creating SiYuan documents in bulk.
authorLimitTip: Maximum number of authors displayed per item; the rest is replaced with "et al.". 0 means no limit.
librarySyncIntervalTip: Minutes between automatic Zotero library refreshes; 0 disables auto sync.
noteSyncIntervalTip: Minutes between automatic uploads of changed notes to Zotero; 0 disables it.
syncModeTip: Incremental sync compares Zotero local versions first, fetching only changed items and detecting deletions; full sync downloads the entire library every time.
workflowQueueEnabledTip: Allows Kimi Work to import papers and AI-written content through the plugin-private job directory. The plugin does not generate reports or overwrite conflicts on its own.
empty: No items. Refresh or check the Zotero connection.
selectNotebook: Select a notebook in the plugin settings first.
connectionFailed: Cannot connect to Zotero 10+. Start Zotero and allow other applications to communicate with it in Settings → Advanced.
syncPreviewTip: Rendered preview of the exact content to be uploaded; formats that may be lost on upload are listed below.
emptyNote: Note is empty; continuing will create or update an empty Zotero note.
syncConflict: The Zotero note changed elsewhere. Nothing was overwritten; resolve the conflict and retry.
authorizationDenied: Zotero write authorization was not granted.
unsupported: Some content could not be converted
lossTitle: Formats that may be lost on upload
lossMath: Math (LaTeX): formula rendering is lost, only the source text is kept
lossTaskList: Task lists: checkboxes are lost, only text is kept
lossEmbed: Embedded content (iframe, audio, video): the player is removed
lossDetails: Collapsible blocks: folding is lost, content is kept
lossHighlight: Highlighted text (==text==): the highlight style is lost, text is kept
lossCodeHighlight: Code syntax highlighting: code is kept, highlighting colors are lost
lossInlineStyle: Inline styles such as text colors: styles are lost, text is kept
lossImageStyle: Image size and alignment attributes: only the image and its alt text are kept
lossIndent: Paragraph indentation: indent styling is lost, text is kept
lossBlockRef: SiYuan block references and SiYuan links: cannot jump back to SiYuan from Zotero
